LanguageData.APM_BuriedLegacy.scenario.summary: Explore a forgotten mechanitor complex, find a dead master's legacy, and claim an abandoned army as your own. A classic Apex Mechanoids experience.
LanguageData.APM_BuriedLegacy.scenario.parts.GameStar: Years of searching led you to the buried domain of a long-dead mechanitor. Guided by a faint signal, you step into a silent base where a skeleton rots inside a locked command casket, undone by his own mistakes. The base, the machinery, and the dormant army are now yours. All that remains is to take the throne.
LanguageData.APM_BuriedLegacy.scenario.name: Buried Legacy
LanguageData.APM_BuriedLegacy.scenario.description: Years of wandering through wastes and abandoned ruins have left behind only scars and a belief in legends. But the legends turned out to be true. Following the faint signal of an ancient transponder, you have discovered the lost complex of an ancient mechanitor. Inside, locked within his command casket, lies the skeleton of the previous owner, killed centuries ago by his own foolishness. All around is silence, broken only by the hum of generators and the quiet echo of a bygone glory. The rest of the once-proud garrison lies in ruins scattered across the territory, reduced to scrap by time and neglect. Only the units secured inside stasis containers remain intact. This entire base and the remnants of a bygone army now belong to you. All that is left is to claim the throne and accept your destiny.
LanguageData.APM_BuriedLegacy.label: Buried Legacy
